target: I need a taxi to the train station. There are two people and three bags. How much will it cost?

chatgpt.assessment: Preserves taxi and price question; explicitly declines unsupported detail.

claude.proposed: move_taxi + move_public + qty_2 + punct_question; money_coins + punct_question
claude.assessment: Uses documented tiles but quantity attachment to a taxi is context-dependent rather than a documented passenger construction.

gemini.proposed: move_taxi + move_public; move_feet + qty_2 + qty_plus; money_coins + punct_question
gemini.assessment: No invented IDs, but treats movement and more as passengers/luggage without documented support.

mistral.proposed: move_taxi + move_public + punct_question; qty_2 + qty_3 + money_coins + punct_question
mistral.assessment: Mixes later correction with unsupported IDs and unattached quantity tiles.

microsoft_copilot.proposed: move_taxi + move_public + qty_2 + qty_5 + punct_question; money_coins + punct_question
microsoft_copilot.assessment: Uses existing IDs but states undocumented whole-phrase quantity and luggage readings as protocol rules.

finding: One conservative response preserves priority-first meaning better than richer unsupported encodings. The guide did not prevent all symbol/rule invention.
